title: Civil Liability Indexation Notice 2026
version_kind: in force from 2026-07-01; the current in-force version on the retrieval date
converter: qld_convert.py (Legalese Commons scratch script, Python 3.12 html.parser; not kept in the repository)
conversion: HTML 'whole' view to UTF-8 plain text: Chapter/Part/Division/Schedule headings kept as tab-indented lines ('Part 1 — Name'); sections as '<number><TAB><heading>'; paragraph numbers kept; tables one row per line as '| a | b |'; amendment-history notes (class view-history-note), links, scripts and site chrome removed; attribution and unofficial-version notice prepended.
note: Sets the 2026-27 amounts under the Civil Liability Act 2003, s 75: the loss of consortium amount (s 58(1)(b)), the base and variable amounts for general damages by injury scale value (s 62(2)-(3)), and the s 64(2) future loss amount. Repeals the 2025 Notice.
